description: This file defines functions for generating documentation of supported PyTorch JIT operations, including tensor methods, functional ops, builtins, and math functions, primarily for use with Sphinx autodoc.

methods.name: _hidden
methods.description: Checks if a name is considered internal or hidden based on naming conventions.

methods.name: _emit_type
methods.description: Converts a type object to its string representation.

methods.name: _emit_arg
methods.description: Formats a function argument with its name, type, and default value.

methods.name: _emit_args
methods.description: Joins multiple formatted arguments into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: _emit_rets
methods.description: Formats multiple return types, possibly as a tuple.

methods.name: _emit_schema
methods.description: Generates a string schema representation for a function or operator.

methods.name: _get_tensor_ops
methods.description: Retrieves supported tensor methods for torch.Tensor.

methods.name: _get_nn_functional_ops
methods.description: Retrieves supported functions from torch.nn.functional and related modules.

methods.name: _get_builtins_helper
methods.description: Collects built-in functions and operators, filtering out internal or unsupported ones.

methods.name: _is_math_fn
methods.description: Checks if a function belongs to the math module.

methods.name: _get_torchscript_builtins
methods.description: Retrieves schemas for TorchScript built-in functions excluding math functions.

methods.name: _get_math_builtins
methods.description: Retrieves schemas for math functions, excluding tensor-related schemas.

methods.name: _get_global_builtins
methods.description: Retrieves schemas for global Python built-in functions supported in TorchScript.

methods.name: _list_supported_ops
methods.description: Generates a documentation section listing all supported operations.
